notes: Variant v005 is a selected unit over φρονεῖ and changes nothing in the projection.
The three κυρίῳ datives are analysed alike as anarthrous nouns taking their supplied determiner and case preposition (rules 21, 24, 51).
Both εὐχαριστεῖ units are headed on thanks, discontinuously around God, on rule 91's unbroken corpus line for that lexeme.
